NEW YORK, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — **Shop. Stock Up. Build Your Future.**[WeShop Holdings Limited](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=r5Q-y6eHZ8PMZzo6EkDyRMN9TNg_R0SXZhWCtXZeUatDfOXP1Tb5W7gIJbijTlbJ3v4yq9o7C4Vfd2YyxNvlDwF7At27DRB6v5PmjZdSQUw=) (“WeShop” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: WSHP), the community-owned shopping platform that turns everyday purchases into ownership, today announced the official U.S. launch of its free shopping app. U.S. consumers can shop more than 750 participating retailers, earn ShareBack™ rewards and build ownership in WeShop through eligible everyday purchases and referrals.


WeShop continues to add new retailers regularly and has partnered with seven leading affiliate networks including Awin, CJ, Impact, Rakuten, FlexOffers, Loyalize and SitePlug. Members can shop well-known brands across department stores, e-commerce marketplaces, travel, tech, fashion and beauty, including LG, eBay and Booking.com.


“Traditional loyalty programs reward consumers for spending, but WeShop takes that concept a step further. WeShop is designed to complement the rewards ecosystem, giving consumers another way to benefit from purchases they are already making,” said Maria Weaver, CEO of WeShop. “Through ShareBack, eligible purchases earn members WePoints that can be redeemed for WeShop shares. Our goal is to make ownership more accessible and easier to understand, even for someone who has never owned stock before. We’re not asking consumers to change their shopping habits. We’re giving them another way to participate in the value they help create.”


WeShop’s ShareBack™ program allows eligible members to earn WePoints by shopping with participating retailers or referring others to the platform. Members can redeem their accumulated points for WeShop Class A ordinary shares, subject to the program’s terms and applicable requirements, adding an ownership component to traditional shopping rewards. Members can also continue earning their usual credit card rewards and retailer loyalty points, where applicable.


To celebrate the launch, members can earn double ShareBack™ rewards on eligible purchases through 11:59 p.m. ET on December 1, 2026, covering Black Friday and Cyber Monday.


**Connecting Brands with Consumers at the Moment of Discovery**
For retailers, WeShop offers another way to reach consumers as they explore products and make purchase decisions. A member booking a trip, for example, may also be looking for luggage, holiday clothing or beauty essentials, creating opportunities for brands across categories to reach shoppers with complementary products.


By bringing shopping, recommendations and rewards together on one platform, WeShop connects brands with consumers around their interests and upcoming plans while giving members an additional incentive to shop through the opportunity to earn WeShop shares.


**Creators, Meet Ownership**
WeShop is working with[Parity](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=f3koid2NxcwGSflIFuGcyM9tkdGtpdigmgzWhm8NQewXJ78e9W-XXcvFVxjh2Z1brolGwspbH3AnKrEXXAjfVA==) ,[BrandStory Architech](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kYor0sHCX0uS5d_7LNl6wdWZ7xVb9T75YZEyOnpP6HuIJa6wddufoJj-T_4kphKqHL1TozTOP-u3eheCOqAtihEi2E_ARrFQdjNQ66hjvqem9-uWvcOwx_nSeZO2EHgi) , and[THTWRKS](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pLaCUZY7swuaaZuoPAJ364XiRfEcViYfpCromG8WeX_u_p42I3CsQ-vBuUXksJoKhLPBQOCxIkDkmkVdWF_71w==) to bring athletes, creators and music artists onto the platform as founding members. Through these relationships, creators will introduce their audiences and fans to WeShop and show how everyday shopping can earn ShareBack™ rewards, supporting the Company’s mission to make shared ownership more accessible.


“WeShop is helping people see themselves not just as consumers, but as equity owners,” said Weaver. “By working with athletes, creators and music artists, we’re introducing more people to a new way to participate in ownership through everyday purchases.”


**Bringing WeShop to Local Communities**
To celebrate its U.S. launch, WeShop will host events in Charlotte, Columbus, Dallas-Fort Worth and Atlanta, in partnership with beloved local creators and influencers. The events will introduce consumers to the app, highlight participating retailers and give attendees an opportunity to learn how everyday purchases can translate into WeShop ownership through the ShareBack™ program.


Consumers can download the free WeShop app through the[Apple App Store](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=xNFK9dfsrACGLZ4Pr0LBNVwQsCY9w8TwYbyiNcvrs3QYi8zUnTaFesYhlhqMVmLYiwgDPC7McBajj0wOGWZKOgDRG0RBYsynC-4D4WLw7JlYuxvUDqGb-w3gH2D7yixTSSZ23GNjk6tTbfwv8n-GEI2II--7Z02C2STl_j8eM_xM3c2PP8DcNh4_CjKX1NMLAvG7vzR7yRHh1pFFgXnCtIGBkU830EiUKrku1J0BpKYs5cY3NB1Pr4HWjfWBalPzZob_9UE9o-gaCRl0t_tdQjGm5tqIc5tvUrYnqxDGR3BPHrIv6V9NMUTqKdJDk3nzN2P6HSKjb4uis9adX64-Sg==) or[Google Play](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NT2jnnriWw27_okRKnHeaGTg9HhMdA4BeCOVbGnh7V5h73xzNgVlTtNu5SA5yHXLj7kuPJOSgE64CLW-8WVVya6HYgvoSO6MfUk-GAN61_rmNC1baSQWabamt8Hp7Co0p5pcM-8I8hU2TyuoszkrhliombJzK8ejpgFH0W8zM2Ar2oGfsQxe7CsHys0jU7n6ivsaBTXyJVMrqrWHnNdwzGw7F5QQhpnU4WZ1E1uV4G4Hf7NXf4dnJPAHXWdyRyw3y-sQkumidPNf71KKEe5XDXtSis13xnkaGGi5qZLXj86WCxYPGTTRwDnlC8pBnzaQqkdPteEcuQRFJgNlK6nYOvrvAizZiKgBuNkOyIpceMw=) .


**About WeShop**
WeShop Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: WSHP) is a community-owned shopping platform that turns everyday purchases into ownership. Through its proprietary ShareBack™ program, members earn ShareBack™ rewards, or WePoints, redeemable for shares in WeShop, when they shop and refer others to the platform, giving the people who help grow the company the opportunity to own a piece of it. With access to hundreds of leading retailers and more than a billion products, WeShop brings shopping, rewards and ownership together in one experience. By putting consumers at the center, WeShop is building a community where members are more than shoppers; they are shareholders.
